nbd_root_path.description: Directory where NBD-served root filesystem images for clients are stored.

nbd_enabled.description: Enable or disable the NBD server that serves the client root filesystem.

tftp_root_path.description: Directory containing boot files (kernel, initrd, pxelinux.cfg) served via TFTP.

tftp_enabled.description: Enable or disable the TFTP server required for PXE boot of clients.

dns_domain.description: DNS domain name assigned to LTSP clients (e.g., for hostnames like client01.ltsp.local).

default_gateway.description: IP address of the gateway/router clients should use for external networks.

dhcp_enabled.description: Enable the built-in DHCP server (dnsmasq) to assign IP addresses to LTSP clients.

dhcp_start.description: First IP address in the DHCP lease range for thin clients.

dhcp_end.description: Last IP address in the DHCP lease range for thin clients.

subnet_mask.description: IPv4 subnet mask in CIDR notation (e.g., '24' for 255.255.255.0).

nameserver.description: Primary DNS server IP address for clients. Typically the server's own IP or gateway.

nameservers.description: Additional DNS server IP addresses for clients (comma-separated list of IPs).

locale.description: Default system locale and language for client sessions.

pulseaudio_enabled.description: Enable PulseAudio redirection — allows clients to stream audio to server or remote hosts.

xorg_autodetect.description: Let Xorg auto-detect display hardware in clients instead of using static configs.

client_kernel_modules.description: List of kernel modules that must be loaded in the client image at boot.

client_packages.description: List of packages to install in the LTSP client root filesystem (chroot).

ltsp_image_path.description: Base path to the client root filesystem directory (chroot) used by LTSP.

ltsp_compress.description: Compress the client image (squashfs) to reduce network I/O and memory usage.

nbd_compress.description: Compression algorithm to use for NBD-served root filesystems.

local_login.description: Allow users to log in locally on client machines (e.g., for admin access).

allow_root_login.description: Permit root login directly via display manager or SSH on clients.

session_type.description: Default desktop environment for client sessions.

kernel_params.description: Additional kernel command-line parameters passed to clients on boot.

ltsp_build_scripts_dir.description: Optional directory containing custom scripts to override/extend LTSP image build steps.

ssh_enabled.description: Enable SSH server in the client image (for remote admin or debugging).

ssh_port.description: SSH port number on client systems (only used if SSH is enabled).

ssh_authorized_keys.description: List of public SSH keys (as single-line strings) to pre-install for root login on clients.

usb_redirect_enabled.description: Allow USB devices connected to clients to be redirected to the server (via USBIP or similar).

printer_redirect_enabled.description: Enable printing from clients via server (IPP or local CUPS).

audio_redirect_enabled.description: Redirect client audio output to the server (requires PulseAudio or similar).

serial_redirect_enabled.description: Allow access to client serial ports from the server (for device control).

hw_accel_enabled.description: Enable hardware video acceleration (VAAPI/VDPAU) in client X11 sessions.

persistence_enabled.description: Enable per-user persistent storage (overlay) on clients for saved settings/files.

persistence_root_path.description: Directory where per-client persistence overlays are stored (used only if enabled).

auto_image_update.description: Automatically rebuild the LTSP client image when core packages are updated.

secure_boot_enabled.description: Enable UEFI Secure Boot support for 64-bit UEFI clients.

uefi_bootloader_path.description: Path to the UEFI bootloader (e.g., signed shim) for Secure Boot-enabled clients.
